CVE-2023-27536.title: curl: GSS delegation too eager connection re-use
CVE-2023-27536.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in libcurl prior to v8.0.0 where it reuses a previously established GSS-negotiate connection.

CVE-2024-EL5KEY.title: curl: hypothetical vulnerability filed under a malformed top-level key
CVE-2024-EL5KEY.description: The Oracle feed sometimes keys a release as "el5" instead of "5". The range identifier decides the bucket, so the malformed key is ignored rather than producing one.
